verdict.rationale: Brex documents automations such as AI invoice entry, GL coding, approval flows and auto-enforced budget controls. A spend platform could plausibly version its policies and automations, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows that Brex automations can be versioned, reviewed through change history or diffs, or rolled back. Pipedream and Zapier recipes are external integration platforms, not Brex's own versioning capability, so they earn no credit.
